title: MedicationRecord
description: A single medication entry extracted from an encounter transcript by the ambient-scribe skill.

name_raw.description: The drug name exactly as spoken/transcribed. Never normalized at extraction time.

name_resolved.description: The RxNorm-normalized drug name, or null if no confident resolution.

rxcui.description: RxNorm Concept Unique Identifier, or null.

dose.description: Numeric dose as stated. Null if dose was not stated, or if the stated dose was a range/uncertain (see dose_raw).

dose_raw.description: Raw dose string from the transcript, populated when the dose is uncertain or expressed as a range.

frequency.description: Frequency as stated (e.g., 'once daily', 'BID', 'TID', 'QID', 'q4h', 'q6h', 'PRN', 'weekly'). Null if not stated.

indication.description: Indication only if stated in the encounter. Null otherwise.

citations.description: Turn IDs from the transcript supporting this entry.

unresolved.description: True if the validator could not confidently resolve the drug name. Such entries appear in Needs Clinician Verification.

uncertain_dose.description: True if the dose was stated ambiguously (e.g., '20 or 40 mg').

validator_warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings emitted by medication_validator.py (unit/route mismatch, same-class duplicate, etc.).
